13	#ifndef ORC_RT_NATIVEDYLIBMANAGER_H
14	#define ORC_RT_NATIVEDYLIBMANAGER_H
15	
16	#include "orc-rt/BootstrapInfo.h"
17	#include "orc-rt/Service.h"
18	#include "orc-rt/sps-ci/NativeDylibManagerSPSCI.h"
19	
20	namespace orc_rt {
21	
22	class Session;
23	
24	/// Dylib loading / symbol lookup service.
25	///
26	/// Libraries loaded through this service are automatically unloaded in LIFO
27	/// order at session shutdown via Session::addOnShutdown callbacks registered
28	/// from load().
29	class NativeDylibManager : public Service {
30	public:
31	  enum LookupFlags { RequiredSymbol, WeaklyReferencedSymbol };
32	  using SymbolLookupSet = std::vector<std::pair<std::string, LookupFlags>>;
33	
34	  /// Create a NativeDylibManager, adding associated symbols to the given
35	  /// SimpleSymbolTable (typically the BootstrapInfo table).
36	  static Expected<std::unique_ptr<NativeDylibManager>>
37	  Create(Session &S, SimpleSymbolTable &ST,
38	         const char *InstanceName = "orc_rt_ci_NativeDylibManager_Instance",
39	         SimpleSymbolTable::MutatorFn AddInterface =
40	             sps_ci::addNativeDylibManager);
41	
42	  /// Convenience constructor that adds default symbols to the given
43	  /// BootstrapInfo's symbols map.
44	  static Expected<std::unique_ptr<NativeDylibManager>>
45	  Create(Session &S, BootstrapInfo &BI) {
46	    return Create(S, BI.symbols());
47	  }
48	
49	  /// NativeDylibManager is not copyable / moveable.
50	  NativeDylibManager(const NativeDylibManager &) = delete;
51	  NativeDylibManager &operator=(const NativeDylibManager &) = delete;
52	  NativeDylibManager(NativeDylibManager &&) = delete;
53	  NativeDylibManager &operator=(NativeDylibManager &&) = delete;
54	
55	  /// Load the given library.
56	  ///
57	  /// Returns an Expected handle. On success, registers a Session shutdown
58	  /// callback to unload the library.
59	  ///
60	  /// As a special case, an empty Path returns the process's global lookup
61	  /// handle.
62	  using OnLoadCompleteFn = move_only_function<void(Expected<void *>)>;
63	  void load(OnLoadCompleteFn &&OnComplete, std::string Path);
64	
65	  /// Lookup addresses of the given symbols in the given library.
66	  ///
67	  /// Each entry in Symbols pairs a name with a flag indicating whether the
68	  /// symbol is required or weakly referenced. A missing required symbol is
69	  /// reported as an empty optional in the result vector; a missing
70	  /// weakly-referenced symbol is reported as a present optional with a zero
71	  /// (nullptr) address. This matches the resolve semantics of
72	  /// llvm::orc::rt_bootstrap::SimpleExecutorDylibManager.
73	  using OnLookupCompleteFn =
74	      move_only_function<void(Expected<std::vector<std::optional<void *>>>)>;
75	  void lookup(OnLookupCompleteFn &&OnLookupComplete, void *Handle,
76	              SymbolLookupSet Symbols);
77	
78	  void onDetach(Service::OnCompleteFn OnComplete,
79	                bool ShutdownRequested) override;
80	  void onShutdown(Service::OnCompleteFn OnComplete) override;
81	
82	private:
83	  NativeDylibManager(Session &S) : S(S) {}
84	
85	  Session &S;
86	};
87	
88	} // namespace orc_rt

34	/// Standalone MachO unwind-info registration via libunwind's
35	/// unw_find_dynamic_unwind_sections mechanism.
36	///
37	/// MachO-Platform provides unwind-info registration as part of its broader
38	/// MachO support, and should be preferred. Use this class only for MachO
39	/// executors that deliberately omit the full platform.
40	class StandaloneMachOUnwindInfoRegistrar {
41	  // Unit-test access to the private UnwindInfoMap. The fixture is defined in
42	  // orc-rt/unittests/StandaloneMachOUnwindInfoRegistrarTest.cpp.
43	  friend class UnwindInfoMapTest;
44	
45	public:
46	  /// Represents a registration with libunwind that will enable registration
47	  /// of unwind info. Destruction will trigger a release of the registration,
48	  /// so clients must keep this alive throughout the lifetime of their
49	  /// Session.
50	  class Registration {
51	    friend class StandaloneMachOUnwindInfoRegistrar;
52	
53	  public:
54	    Registration() = default;
55	    Registration(Registration &&Other);
56	    Registration &operator=(Registration &&Other);
57	    ~Registration();
58	
59	  private:
60	    Registration(bool Active);
61	    bool Active = false;
62	  };

65	  enable(SimpleSymbolTable &ST,
66	         SimpleSymbolTable::MutatorFn AddInterface =
67	             sps_ci::addStandaloneMachOUnwindInfoRegistrar);
68	
69	  static Error registerSections(std::vector<ExecutorAddrRange> CodeRanges,
70	                                ExecutorAddr DSOBase,
71	                                ExecutorAddrRange DWARFEHFrame,
72	                                ExecutorAddrRange CompactUnwind);
73	  static Error deregisterSections(std::vector<ExecutorAddrRange> CodeRanges);

76	  /// Describes the unwind-info sections associated with one or more code
77	  /// ranges. The struct layout is identical to libunwind's
78	  /// unw_dynamic_unwind_sections class so that the libunwind callback can
79	  /// populate its caller with a direct assignment.
80	  ///
81	  /// This struct must be kept in sync with libunwind's
82	  /// unw_dynamic_unwind_sections; if the two ever drift, the libunwind
83	  /// callback will silently corrupt unwind info.
84	  struct DynamicUnwindSections {
85	    uintptr_t DSOBase;
86	    uintptr_t DWARFSection;

115	      uintptr_t End;
116	    };
117	
118	    mutable std::mutex M;

13	#ifndef ORC_RT_SERVICE_H
14	#define ORC_RT_SERVICE_H
15	
16	#include "orc-rt/Error.h"
17	#include "orc-rt/move_only_function.h"
18	
19	namespace orc_rt {
20	
21	/// A Service typically manages some resource(s) or performs some actions on
22	/// behalf of a Session. E.g. a Memory Manager service.
23	/// Services are owned by the Session and notified when the controller
24	/// detaches, and when the Session shuts down.
25	class Service {
26	public:
27	  using OnCompleteFn = move_only_function<void()>;
28	
29	  virtual ~Service();
30	
31	  /// Called when controller access becomes permanently unavailable.
32	  ///
33	  /// This is guaranteed to be called exactly once before onShutdown,
34	  /// regardless of how the Session reaches that state. It is called when:
35	  ///   - The controller explicitly disconnects.
36	  ///   - The Session::detach() method is called.
37	  ///   - The Session shuts down (even if no controller was ever attached).
38	  ///
39	  /// After onDetach is called no further requests will be made to the Service
40	  /// by the controller. Note that JIT'd code may continue to make requests to
41	  /// the service concurrent with a call to onDetach.
42	  ///
43	  /// If ShutdownRequested is true then a Session shutdown is already pending,
44	  /// and will proceed after all Services have been notified of the detach.
45	  ///
46	  /// onDetach provides an opportunity for Services to release any resources
47	  /// that are only required while the Session is attached to the controller.
48	  /// It is expected that many Services will implement this operation as a
49	  /// no-op.
50	  virtual void onDetach(OnCompleteFn OnComplete, bool ShutdownRequested) = 0;
51	
52	  /// The onShutdown operation will be called at the end of the session.
53	  ///
54	  /// The Service should release any held resources.
55	  virtual void onShutdown(OnCompleteFn OnComplete) = 0;
56	};
57	} // namespace orc_rt
58	
59	#endif // ORC_RT_SERVICE_H

Now I have all the information needed. Here's my analysis of the memory management, dynamic library, and resource-services subsystem in the LLVM orc-rt project:

---

## Summary of orc-rt Memory Management and Dynamic Library Subsystems

### 1. **include/orc-rt/SimpleNativeMemoryMap.h / lib/executor/SimpleNativeMemoryMap.cpp**

**Purpose:** JIT memory management backend that allocates, protects, and tracks memory regions using native OS APIs (mmap/VirtualAlloc). Handles reservation, initialization, deinitialization, and release of memory slabs.

**Key Classes/Functions:**
- `SimpleNativeMemoryMap` (extends `Service`) - Main class managing memory slabs
- `reserve()` / `release()` - Reserve/free address space slabs
- `initialize()` / `deinitialize()` - Write content, apply permissions, run alloc actions
- `InitializeRequest` - Contains segments (with `AllocGroup` permissions) and `AllocActionPair`s

**Connection:** Extends `Service` (registered with Session). Uses `SimpleSymbolTable` to expose its API interface via RPC symbols. Integrates with `AllocAction` and `MemoryFlags`.

---

### 2. **include/orc-rt/MemoryFlags.h**

**Purpose:** Defines memory permissions (R/W/X) and lifetime policies for JIT memory allocations.

**Key Classes/Functions:**
- `MemProt` enum - `Read`, `Write`, `Exec`, `None` (bitmask flags)
- `MemLifetime` enum - `Standard` (explicit deallocation) vs `Finalize` (auto-deallocated)
- `AllocGroup` - Combines `MemProt` + `MemLifetime` into a single compact value
- `AllocGroupSmallMap<T>` - Specialized map for AllocGroup-keyed data

**Connection:** Used by `SimpleNativeMemoryMap::InitializeRequest::Segment` to specify permissions for each memory region. Pure data types, not a Service.

---

### 3. **include/orc-rt/AllocAction.h**

**Purpose:** Callbacks for allocation finalization (after memory is written/protected) and deallocation (before memory is freed). Enables custom cleanup like TLB invalidation or key registration.

**Key Classes/Functions:**
- `AllocActionFn` - Function pointer type taking serialized args, returning error buffer
- `AllocAction` - Pairs an `AllocActionFn` with serialized argument buffer
- `AllocActionPair` - Contains `Finalize` and `Dealloc` actions
- `runFinalizeActions()` / `runDeallocActions()` - Executes actions with rollback on failure

**Connection:** Used by `SimpleNativeMemoryMap` via `InitializeRequest::AAPs`. Actions run during `initialize()` (finalize) and `deinitialize()`/`release()` (dealloc). Not a Service.

---

### 4. **include/orc-rt/NativeDylibManager.h / lib/executor/NativeDylibManager.cpp**

**Purpose:** Manages dynamic library loading and symbol lookup using native OS APIs (dlopen/dlsym on Unix, LoadLibrary/GetProcAddress on Windows). Automatically unloads libraries at session shutdown.

**Key Classes/Functions:**
- `NativeDylibManager` (extends `Service`) - Main class
- `load()` - Loads a library, registers shutdown callback for unload
- `lookup()` - Looks up symbols by name with strong/weak reference semantics
- `SymbolLookupSet` - Vector of (name, `LookupFlags`) pairs
- `LookupFlags` - `RequiredSymbol` vs `WeaklyReferencedSymbol`

**Connection:** Extends `Service` (registered with Session). Uses `SimpleSymbolTable` to expose its RPC interface. Empty path returns global lookup handle (RTLD_DEFAULT).

---

### 5. **include/orc-rt/StandaloneMachOUnwindInfoRegistrar.h / lib/executor/StandaloneMachOUnwindInfoRegistrar.cpp**

**Purpose:** Registers MachO unwind info (DWARF EH frames and compact unwind) with libunwind via the `unw_find_dynamic_unwind_sections` mechanism. For macOS executors without full MachO-Platform support.

**Key Classes/Functions:**
- `StandaloneMachOUnwindInfoRegistrar` - Static API class (NOT a Service)
- `Registration` - RAII handle keeping libunwind registration active
- `enable()` - Registers callback with libunwind, adds symbols to table
- `registerSections()` / `deregisterSections()` - Manage code-range to unwind-info mappings
- `UnwindInfoMap` - Internal interval map from code addresses to `DynamicUnwindSections`

**Connection:** NOT a Service. Uses `SimpleSymbolTable` to add its interface symbols. Calls `__unw_add_find_dynamic_unwind_sections` (macOS 15+ libunwind API).

---

### 6. **include/orc-rt/SimpleSymbolTable.h / lib/executor/SimpleSymbolTable.cpp**

**Purpose:** Simple string-to-pointer map for symbol registration. Used to expose Service APIs to the JIT process via RPC callable symbols.

**Key Classes/Functions:**
- `SimpleSymbolTable` - Wraps `std::unordered_map<std::string, const void*>`
- `addUnique()` - Adds symbols only if no conflicting definitions exist
- `MutatorFn` - Function type for mutating the table (used by Service Create methods)

**Connection:** NOT a Service. Utility class used by Services (`SimpleNativeMemoryMap`, `NativeDylibManager`) to register their RPC-callable methods. The BootstrapInfo contains a global instance.

---

## Service Interface Relationships

| Class | Extends Service? | Purpose |
|-------|------------------|---------|
| `SimpleNativeMemoryMap` | Yes | Allocate/protect JIT memory |
| `NativeDylibManager` | Yes | dlopen/dlsym for JIT code |
| `StandaloneMachOUnwindInfoRegistrar` | No | Unwind info registration utility |
| `SimpleSymbolTable` | No | Symbol name-to-address map |
| `MemoryFlags` types | No | Permission/lifetime data |
| `AllocAction` types | No | Finalize/dealloc callbacks |

All Services implement `onDetach()` (controller disconnect) and `onShutdown()` (session cleanup) from the `Service` base class. Services register themselves with a `Session` and expose their APIs via symbols added to a `SimpleSymbolTable`.
